cd /private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec111/fx/system-spec; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,glob,json
for f in sorted(glob.glob("*.md")):
    t=open(f).read()
    for kw in ["請求漏れ","漏れ","検知","O1","O2","表計算への書き出し","エクスポート"]:
        for m in re.finditer(re.escape(kw),t):
            line=t[t.rfind("\n",0,m.start())+1:t.find("\n",m.end())]
            print(f,kw,"::",line[:200])
            break
s=json.load(open("spec-state.json"))
print(json.dumps(s["matrix"],ensure_ascii=False)[:300])
# any objective->cell trace field?
for k in ["design_applications","doctrine_applications"]:
    print(k, list(s[k].keys()))
print(json.dumps(s["decisions"][0],ensure_ascii=False)[:600])
EOF
